notes:
Mid-market product team focused on surfacing more relevant product recommendations inside their app. Short, tactical objective: reduce 'no-click' and increase CTR on top-3 results by running an offline rerank POC. Conversation flow: start with Redwood Hosted API to validate model/rerank approach, then evaluate cost and SLA tradeoffs for Dedicated reservation (predictable throughput + data isolation).

Key ask from product: reranking endpoint that accepts upstream candidate lists (BM25 + heuristics) and returns stable scored ordering; need offline scoring for A/B evals and ability to replay historical queries. Priya recommended Redwood's rerank endpoint + eval hooks; Linchpin engineering wants exportable scores for in-house offline metrics.

Latency/throughput targets: 95th p50 <= 60ms for single-item rerank at 10 requests/sec baseline in-hosted POC; target for Dedicated is sustained 200 rps with 95th p50 <= 80ms under batching. Cost sensitivity: mid (wants to avoid 3x token-cost premium), will consider quantized model variants and batching.

Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML integration (Okta), audit logs for scoring decisions, per-customer data residency (US), and KMS for key management. Legal flagged retention_controls and data residency; security team asked for SOC2/ISO artifacts (we provided SOC2 link).

POC notes: offline scoring run completed on eval-set-v2.csv (drive link). Early results: +12% MRR uplift on relevance metric (preliminary) vs BM25 baseline; quality team wants to expand eval set to 200k queries and add human judgment pass.

Quotes/snippets: "If we can get deterministic rerank scores and export them, we can run nightly offline experiments and promote models into production via canary rollouts." — Head of Product.
